title: Medievalism, Popular Culture and Politics in Metal Music
summary: This book explores how metal's medievalizing epicism connects with pop culture and politics. Focusing on medieval Hispanic epic themes, it examines whether and how bands address the sexist, racist, nationalist, and exclusionary undertones tied to medievalizing epicism, and what this means for the broader metal scene. A PDF version of this book will be available for free in Open Access. It has been made available under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public Licence and is part of Knowledge Unlatched.
